summary.text: Cale Case is a Republican member of the Wyoming State Senate for District 25, in office since 1999, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is an economist who earlier served in the Wyoming House of Representatives from 1993 to 1998.

paragraphs.text: Cale Case earned a B.A. and a Ph.D. in economics and works as an economist, according to Ballotpedia.
He was a candidate for U.S. House in Wyoming's at-large district in 2004.

For 2025-2026 Case chaired the Senate Corporations, Elections and Political Subdivisions Committee and the joint committee of the same name, and co-chaired the Select Committee on Tribal Relations, the Select Committee on Legislative Facilities, Technology, and Process and the Riverton State Office Task Force.
He defeated Lisa Wilson in the August 18, 2026 Republican primary, 62.9% to 37.1%.
